overclaims: The longitudinal study disclaims causal identification, and documented campaigns often had limited reach.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, criteria and outcome (causal_assessment, unresolved, not_applicable) all match. The e3 public excerpt 'no significant audience increase' cuts off 'due to our services'. That turns OpenAI's finding of no reach gained from its tools into an apparent finding of no audience growth at all. The rationale's 'often had limited reach' builds on that: e3 does not measure absolute reach, and e5 does not establish the generated articles' reach. Fix: restore the full e3 phrase and say the campaigns showed no meaningful reach gain attributable to OpenAI's tools.
